slice: stock tires from Kawasaki KX65 / KX85 / KX112 owner's manuals (gap fill)
method: Stock tires per roster bike-year where BAK had no stock tire size and model yet (checked against every docs/research/knowledge file on 2026-11-07). Read from the bike maker's owner's manual or spec page; printed values kept as printed, odd ones noted.

records.topic: 2022 Kawasaki KX112: stock tire sizes, models and cold pressure
records.statement: Kawasaki's 2022 KX112 owner's manual lists a 70/100-19 42M front and 90/100-16 51M rear, Dunlop Geomax MX33F front and MX33 rear; cold pressure 100–125 kPa (14.5–18.1 psi) front and rear.
records.notes: Kawasaki adds: lower pressure for wet, muddy, sandy or slippery tracks; higher on pebbly or hard tracks to prevent damage, at the cost of more skidding.
